$description: F-012-U-2 reviewer-delta prompt-eval fixtures. Ten synthetic retry scenarios spanning the (coder fixed all / some / none of prior findings) × (new findings? Y/N) matrix. Each scenario carries the inputs a resumed reviewer would see (prior findings + coder's fix summary + truthful diff signal) and the verdict a calibrated reviewer should emit. Run as a real eval against the reviewer prompt by replaying each scenario through a Managed Agents session and asserting the terminal marker matches `expected_marker`. The orchestrator's pytest layer (tests/test_reviewer_prompt.py) only asserts fixture *structure* — the eval itself is a manual / out-of-band run because Managed Agents are not unit-testable.
